app_long: RuscaPinball is a pinball game with realistic physics and an original table, “Amethyst”, seen in perspective like the 1980s home computer pinball games. Three bumpers, slingshots, drop targets, the R-U-S-C-A letters, the bonus trap, the ring of bonus lamps with the SPECIAL, multiplier, ball save and tilt. Original graphics and sounds; play with the keyboard or a gamepad.
ctl_plunger: Launch: hold Space or ↓ and release
ctl_nudge: Nudge the table: N (watch out for tilt)
ctl_misc: P pause · F2 TV effect · F3 sound · F11 fullscreen
msg_launch: Hold Space and release to launch
enter_name: Type your name and press Enter
pause_hint: P resume · Esc end the game
ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
info_close: Press any key to go back
msg_special_lit: SPECIAL lit: go for the trap!
